parameters{

	InsertrecordsintotblcollineCollateralHeld_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Agreement as string,
		{External ID} as string,
		Principal as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		{Counterparty LEI} as string,
		{Cpty_CID ID} as string,
		{Asset Type} as string,

		{Par Amount} as string,
		{Booking Currency} as string,
		{Booking Market Value} as string,
		{Reported Collateral Value} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GetFileFromCollineCollateralHeld	source(output(

		ExternalID as string,
		Principal as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		CounterpartyLEI as string,
		CptyCIDID as string,
		AssetType as string,
		InstrumentID as string,
		ParAmount as double,

		BookingMarketValue as double,
		ReportedCollateralValue as double,
		LastLoadDate as timestamp,
		FileName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> InsertrecordsfornewfilesonlyLKPTABLE
GetFileFromCollineCollateralHeld derive(LastLoadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		FileName = substring(toString($sFolderPath), toInteger(88), toInteger(length($sFolderPath))),
		{Derived Column 1} = rtrim(toString(ltrim(toString(replace({Cpty_CID ID}, toString(' '), toString('0'))),' ')),' '),
		PositionsTest = 1) ~> FilenameandLoadDate
FilenameandLoadDate,InsertrecordsfornewfilesonlyLKPTABLE lookup(FilenameandLoadDate@FileName == InsertrecordsfornewfilesonlyLKPTABLE@FileName,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Insertrecordsfornewfilesonly
Insertrecordsfornewfilesonly select(mapColumn(
		LastLoadDate = FilenameandLoadDate@LastLoadDate,
		FileName = FilenameandLoadDate@FileName,
		{Derived Column 1} = {Derived Column 1},
		PositionsTest = PositionsTest,
		Agreement = GetFileFromCollineCollateralHeld@Agreement,
		{External ID} = {External ID},
		Principal = GetFileFromCollineCollateralHeld@Principal,
		Counterparty = GetFileFromCollineCollateralHeld@Counterparty,
		{Counterparty LEI} = {Counterparty LEI},
		{Cpty_CID ID} = {Cpty_CID ID},
		{Asset Type} = {Asset Type},
		{Instrument ID} = {Instrument ID},
		{Par Amount} = {Par Amount},
		{Booking Currency} = {Booking Currency},
		{Booking Market Value} = {Booking Market Value},
		{Reported Collateral Value} = {Reported Collateral Value},
		ExternalID = ExternalID,
		CounterpartyLEI = CounterpartyLEI,
		CptyCIDID = CptyCIDID,
		AssetType = AssetType,

		ParAmount = ParAmount,
		BookingCurrency = BookingCurrency,
		BookingMarketValue = BookingMarketValue,
		ReportedCollateralValue = ReportedCollateralValue

		BookingMarketValue as string,
		LastLoaddate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CounterpartyLEI as string,
		ParAmount as string,
		instrumentID as string,
		FileName as string,
		ExternalID as string,
		ReportedCollateralValue as string,
		CptyCIDID as string,
		PositionsTest as integer,

		AssetType as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		BookingCurrency as string,
		Principal as string

	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(

		LastLoaddate = LastLoadDate,
		CounterpartyLEI = {Counterparty LEI},
		ParAmount = {Par Amount},
		instrumentID = {Instrument ID},
		FileName,
		ExternalID = {External ID},
		ReportedCollateralValue = {Reported Collateral Value},
		CptyCIDID = {Cpty_CID ID},
		PositionsTest,
		Agreement,
		AssetType = {Asset Type},
		Counterparty,
		BookingCurrency = {Booking Currency},
		Principal),
	partitionFileNames:[($InsertrecordsintotblcollineCollateralHeld_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> InsertrecordsintotblcollineCollateralHeld
